Account.title: Account
Account.subtitle: Manage your profile, security, and how Connex works for you.

AccountProfile.title: Profile
AccountProfile.subtitle: Your personal details. This is how you appear to teammates across every workspace.
AccountProfile.photoHint: A square JPEG, PNG, or WebP image works best.
AccountProfile.photoUploadFailed: Couldn't upload that photo. Please try again.
AccountProfile.photoUnsupported: Choose a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image.
AccountProfile.emailReadonlyHint: Your email is used to sign in. Use “Change email” to update it.
AccountProfile.timezoneHint: Dates and times are shown in this timezone.
AccountProfile.languageHint: Connex and scheduled report emails use this language.
AccountProfile.saveFailed: Couldn't save your profile. Please try again.
AccountProfile.partiallySaved: Some profile changes were saved, but another change failed. Review the current values and try again.

AccountSecurity.title: Passkeys
AccountSecurity.subtitle: Passkeys let you sign in with your fingerprint, face, or a security key instead of a password. These are tied to your account, not this workspace.
AccountSecurity.unsupported: This browser doesn't support passkeys. Try a recent version of Chrome, Safari, Edge, or Firefox.
AccountSecurity.emptyBody: Add a passkey to sign in without a password using your device or a security key.
AccountSecurity.renameDescription: Give this passkey a name you'll recognize, like the device it's on.
AccountSecurity.passwordDescription: Enter your current password before adding your first passkey.
AccountSecurity.incorrectPassword: That password is incorrect. Try again.
AccountSecurity.freshSignInRequired: Sign out and sign in again before adding your first passkey.
AccountSecurity.addFailed: Couldn't add that passkey. Please try again.
AccountSecurity.renameFailed: Couldn't rename that passkey. Please try again.
AccountSecurity.removeFailed: Couldn't remove that passkey. Please try again.

AccountConnections.title: Connected accounts
AccountConnections.subtitle: Connect the mailbox and calendar you already use, then choose exactly what Connex may capture into this workspace.
AccountConnections.actionFailed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
AccountConnections.unavailableBody: This Connex instance has no connected-account providers configured. Ask your administrator to enable Google or Microsoft connections.
AccountConnections.privacyNote: Connecting an account does not start capture. Capture begins only after you save a policy, and you can review or purge captured workspace data at any time.
AccountConnections.error_state: The connection attempt expired or was invalid. Please try again.
AccountConnections.error_denied: The connection was cancelled at the provider.
AccountConnections.error_exchange: The provider rejected the connection. Please try again.
AccountConnections.error_no_offline_access: The provider didn't grant ongoing access. Please try again and approve all requested permissions.

AccountCaptureProvider.title: Relationship capture
AccountCaptureProvider.connectFirst: Connect this account before choosing capture sources or starting a sync.
AccountCaptureProvider.loadFailed: Capture status could not be loaded.

stateDescription.ready: Capture is configured and has produced relationship evidence.
stateDescription.configured: Your policy is saved. Run a sync to begin or continue capture.
stateDescription.notIngesting: Your policy is saved, but ingestion is not authorized for this deployment.
stateDescription.notConfigured: No mail or calendar data is captured until you save a policy.

AccountCapturePolicy.title: Configure relationship capture
AccountCapturePolicy.description: Choose sources, history, and review controls for this provider in the active workspace.
AccountCapturePolicy.workspaceBlockedTitle: Capture is disabled for this workspace
AccountCapturePolicy.workspaceBlockedDescription: A workspace administrator must allow capture before this policy can be saved.
AccountCapturePolicy.enabledHint: You can turn capture off without disconnecting the provider account.
AccountCapturePolicy.streamsDescription: Nothing is selected by default. Enable only the sources you want Connex to inspect.

backfill.label: History window in days
backfill.hint: Choose 1 to {max} days. New policies default to 90 days.

AccountCapturePolicy.includeBodiesHint: Off by default. Bodies are admitted only when both you and the workspace allow them.

exclusions.peopleHint: Comma-separated exact email addresses. Matching conversations are excluded before storage.
exclusions.conversationsHint: Comma-separated provider message, thread, event, or series IDs. Replays remain excluded.

hint.manual: Connex runs only when you choose Sync now, then holds evidence for review.
hint.review: Scheduled sync holds evidence for your approval before it appears in relationship history.
hint.automatic: Scheduled sync admits exact matches. Ambiguous identities always remain in review.

AccountCapturePolicy.effectiveRestrictionDescription: The effective policy may be narrower than your choices. Connex never widens a workspace restriction.

validation.backfill: Enter a whole number from 1 to {max}.

AccountWorkspaceCapturePolicy.title: Workspace capture policy
AccountWorkspaceCapturePolicy.description: Set the maximum capture envelope for this provider in the active workspace.
AccountWorkspaceCapturePolicy.narrowOnlyTitle: Workspace policy can only narrow access
AccountWorkspaceCapturePolicy.narrowOnlyDescription: Operator controls remain authoritative, and each user's policy may narrow these settings further.
AccountWorkspaceCapturePolicy.captureAllowedHint: Turning this off stops provider capture for this workspace.
AccountWorkspaceCapturePolicy.maxBackfillHint: Enter a whole number from 1 to 180 days.
AccountWorkspaceCapturePolicy.includeBodiesAllowedHint: Users must still opt in individually. Metadata remains the default.
AccountWorkspaceCapturePolicy.reviewRequiredHint: Users cannot turn review off while this restriction is enabled.
AccountWorkspaceCapturePolicy.excludePrivateEventsHint: Private, personal, and confidential items are always excluded in full.
AccountWorkspaceCapturePolicy.excludeInternalOnlyHint: Do not admit interactions whose participants are all on excluded workspace domains.
AccountWorkspaceCapturePolicy.excludedDomainsHint: Separate domains with commas. Matching participants are excluded by the workspace policy.
AccountWorkspaceCapturePolicy.validation: Allow at least one source and enter a history window from 1 to 180 days.

AccountCaptureHealth.title: Capture health
AccountCaptureHealth.progressUnknown: {processed} items processed. The provider did not supply a total.

error.tokenExpired: The provider session expired. Reconnect this account.
error.revoked: Provider access was revoked. Reconnect this account.
error.rateLimited: The provider asked Connex to slow down. Sync will retry automatically.
error.cursorInvalid: The provider changed its sync position. Start a new sync.
error.interventionRequired: Review the provider connection before syncing again.
error.purgeFailed: The last purge did not complete. Try again.
error.generic: Capture needs attention before it can continue.

AccountCaptureReviews.title: {provider} review queue
AccountCaptureReviews.description: Resolve unmatched participants and approve held evidence before it enters relationship history.
AccountCaptureReviews.loadFailed: The review queue could not be loaded.
AccountCaptureReviews.emptyDescription: New ambiguous or approval-required items will appear here.
AccountCaptureReviews.approvalDescription: The participant is resolved, but your policy requires approval before capture.
AccountCaptureReviews.attachDescription: Choose the canonical contact this exact participant represents.
AccountCaptureReviews.createDescription: Creation uses the same duplicate preflight as every other contact workflow.
AccountCaptureReviews.rememberExact: Remember this decision only for the same exact, active, unique identity.

AccountCaptureDisclosure.summary: Review scope, data, visibility, and retention

materialExclusion.arbitraryFolders: Folders outside the admitted mail streams
materialExclusion.arbitraryCalendars: Calendars outside the admitted calendar stream
materialExclusion.unmatchedParticipants: Participants that have not been resolved
materialExclusion.body: Message body when body capture is not enabled

visibility.ownerOnly: Visible only to the connected account owner
visibility.recordAccess: Visible to workspace members who can access the linked record
visibility.workspaceActivityEvidence: Visible as workspace activity evidence under record access controls

retention.untilPurged: Retained until you purge captured workspace data
retention.untilPurgedOrDisconnected: Retained until purge or provider disconnect
retention.purgedOnDisconnect: Purged when the provider account is disconnected
retention.purgedOnAccountDeletion: Purged when the connected account owner is deleted

AccountCaptureLifecycle.purgeDescription: Delete captured content and derived relationship evidence from the active workspace.
AccountCaptureLifecycle.disconnectDescription: Remove provider access from your Connex account.
AccountCaptureLifecycle.activeWorkspaceDescription: Captured content, participants, reviews, sync state, and derived activities are removed. Metadata-only audit records remain.
AccountCaptureLifecycle.allWorkspacesTitle: Captured data is purged before disconnect
AccountCaptureLifecycle.allWorkspacesDescription: Connex removes this provider's captured data from every workspace before deleting the credential. This cannot be undone.
AccountCaptureLifecycle.acknowledge: I understand which captured data will be removed.

AccountChangeEmail.title: Change your email
AccountChangeEmail.description: Enter a new email address and your current password. We'll send a confirmation link to the new address.
AccountChangeEmail.successBody: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to finish changing your email. Your current email stays active until then.

PasskeyStepUp.failed: Passkey verification failed. Please try again.
PasskeyStepUp.enrollmentRequired: Add a passkey in Account settings, then try this action again.

AccountNotifications.title: Notifications
AccountNotifications.subtitle: Choose how you're notified. These settings apply to you, not the whole workspace. Email needs a configured SMTP server (Settings → Email).
AccountNotifications.taskDescription: When a task you're assigned is due or overdue.
AccountNotifications.dealDescription: When a deal you own or collaborate on is closing soon or overdue.
AccountNotifications.relationshipDescription: When a contact on one of your open deals goes quiet.
AccountNotifications.mentionDescription: When a teammate @-mentions you in a note.
AccountNotifications.taskMentionDescription: When a teammate @-mentions you in a task.
AccountNotifications.activityMentionDescription: When a teammate @-mentions you in an activity.
AccountNotifications.introductionMentionDescription: When a teammate @-mentions you in an introduction.
AccountNotifications.dealMentionDescription: When a teammate @-mentions you in a deal's close reason.
AccountNotifications.approvalRequestDescription: When a document is sent for your approval.
AccountNotifications.approvalDecisionDescription: When your approval request is approved, rejected, or withdrawn.
AccountNotifications.loadFailed: Your notification preferences couldn't be loaded.
AccountNotifications.saveFailed: Your change couldn't be saved. Try again.

AccountQuietHours.title: Quiet hours
AccountQuietHours.subtitle: Pause in-app and email notifications during the hours you choose. Urgent alerts still come through.
AccountQuietHours.enableDescription: Mute notifications on the days and times you set below.
AccountQuietHours.timezoneHint: Quiet hours follow your account timezone.
AccountQuietHours.saveFailed: Your change couldn't be saved. Try again.

AccountInvites.pendingSubtitle: Workspaces you've been invited to. Accept to join.
AccountInvites.leaveSubtitle: Leave {workspace} and lose access to its data.
AccountInvites.leaveConfirmBody: You'll lose access to this workspace. Your assigned tasks become unassigned and deals you own lose their owner.
